title: PlayStation 5 DualSense Edge Wireless Controller $221.61 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:

[AryaTheExplorer] Would recommend getting some TMR thumbstick modules from aliexpress for 60ish bucks.
[HD9990] exactly. not sure how sony dare selling it at this price..
[Fuzor] Aussies are getting poorer year after year no doubt. I'm the biggest Sony fan but they are also actively trying their hardest to kill themselves from every market they are in:

[topherboi] @sween64: It's a niche product in a niche market, they have a range of digital audio players ranging from $999 up to $6,499.
Much like Apple, some of their products won't appeal to everyone but they are filling a gap.
[Smol Cat] What on earth is that Walkman? That can’t be the normal RRP surely?
[Kammi] This any good?
I used to use the back button add-on for the ps4 controller to play FromSoft games, dunno if this is why good given the pricing
Edit: buy now think later, grabbed a black one
[Wip3out] I loved the back buttons for Returnal, was worth it for that alone for me (and I paid whatever the jacked up RRP was for the 30th Anniversary model - minus the EB trade promo)
[Swankenstein] It has a nice heft but the rubber backing will peel before the sticks wear out just buy the regular dualsense.
[Wip3out] Can get replacement backs off AliExpress at least. This is a pretty shitty factor though given the price.
[safwanc] I got one for the back paddles which work well, but just a heads up that this has terrible battery life and doesn't really feel that premium to justify the cost
[sween64] Is the battery life worse than the normal DualSense?
[Smol Cat] Seems a little worse but not much worse. Definitely stuff prefer this by far compared to the normal one
[safwanc] Significantly worse - I'd guess around 40% less than the normal controller
[p3r514n] I want one in black but the battery life is atrocious.
[BusMan247] The battery life is terrible. Even worse by a margin than the regular. Absolute joke for a controller knowing the regular ps5 controller was $69 and this, with worse battery, but has “back buttons” for $329 rrp. They don’t even have hall sticks.
[He-Mania] This may be an overreaching but I've decided to ditch Sony unless it's some stupidly good deal…. the reason is thier terrible warranty service, PS5 controllers with stick issues they won't address (probably to sell more controllers), the move to discless games (so ppl can't trade) and increasing worse home entertainment product QC - is the reason.
I've just had enough as a long term (decades) customer.
I'm not yet sure if there are better brands and will cross that bridge next time I need a electronics product to replace my existing Sony.
